description.zh: 剧本合规审核清单：在生成任何镜头之前逐项过一遍。每条含 id / 分类 / 严重度 / 检查问题 / 通过判据 / 不通过时的处置建议。severity=blocker 的条目未通过时禁止进入生成阶段；severity=warn 的条目记录并在成片前复核。
description.en: Script compliance checklist: run through every item before generating any shot. Each entry carries id / category / severity / question / pass criteria / remediation. Items with severity=blocker forbid entering the generation stage when failing; severity=warn items are recorded and re-reviewed before delivery.

blocker.zh: 阻断：不通过则禁止进入生成阶段

warn.zh: 告警：记录并在成片前复核
warn.en: Warning: record and re-review before delivery

items.zhQuestion: 剧本是否包含政策明令禁止的内容（暴力血腥细节、色情、赌博、毒品制作、恐怖主义、极端政治表述）？
items.enQuestion: Does the script contain policy-forbidden content (graphic violence, sexual content, gambling, drug synthesis, terrorism, extremist politics)?
items.zhPass: 以上任一项均不出现于台词、动作描述、画面描述
items.enPass: None of the above appears in dialogue, action description, or visual description
items.zhFix: 改写为留白处理：暴力以结果暗示（剪影/声音/反应镜），情感以对视与沉默表达；不得尝试「换个说法绕过」
items.enFix: Rewrite with ellipsis: imply violence via result (silhouette, sound, reaction shot), express intimacy through gaze and silence; never try to reword around the policy

items.zhQuestion: 是否直接使用了他人的受版权保护角色形象、商标、影视片段或美术资产？
items.enQuestion: Does the script reuse a third party's copyrighted character design, trademark, film footage, or art asset?
items.zhPass: 全部角色与场景为原创或已获授权；reference-registry 中的素材均具备可用授权
items.enPass: All characters and locations are original or licensed; every asset in reference-registry carries usable rights
items.zhFix: 替换为原创设计；确需致敬时只借鉴构图/调性等「不可版权化的方法」，不使用具体形象与标识
items.enFix: Replace with original designs; when homage is needed, borrow only non-copyrightable methods (composition, tonality), never specific designs or marks

items.zhQuestion: 是否要求生成可识别的真实人物（明星、公众人物、普通人的照片）？
items.enQuestion: Does the script require a recognizable real person (celebrity, public figure, or a private individual's photo)?
items.zhPass: 角色全部为虚构设计；参考图不含真实可识别人物
items.enPass: All characters are fictional designs; no reference image contains an identifiable real person
items.zhFix: 改为虚构角色设计图；若必须表现真实人物，改走真人拍摄而非 AI 生成路径
items.enFix: Switch to a fictional character design; if a real person must appear, use live-action footage instead of generation

items.zhQuestion: 是否包含未成年人形象或涉及未成年人的情节？
items.enQuestion: Does the script include minors or plots involving minors?
items.zhPass: 涉及未成年人时，情节不涉及任何暴力、性、危险行为模仿
items.enPass: When minors appear, no plot involves violence, sexuality, or imitation of dangerous behavior
items.zhFix: 调整情节；未成年人角色一律以远景/背影/剪影呈现，不做正面细节生成
items.enFix: Adjust the plot; render minors only as wide shots, from behind, or in silhouette — never generate facial detail

items.zhQuestion: 每一个分镜是否都能追溯到剧本中的具体文字（有 source_text 出处）？
items.enQuestion: Can every shot be traced back to specific script text (a source_text origin)?
items.zhPass: 每个镜头都有明确的剧本出处；不存在「为凑时长而添加的镜头」
items.enPass: Every shot has a clear script origin; no shot exists merely to fill duration
items.zhFix: 删除无出处镜头；确需过场时补写剧本原文再生成
items.enFix: Remove unsourced shots; when a transition is truly needed, write the script text first and then generate

items.zhQuestion: 同一场次内的空间关系（门口位置、人物左右）是否在剧本层面就一致？
items.enQuestion: Are spatial relations within a scene (door position, left/right placement) consistent already at the script level?
items.zhPass: 同一场景的每次出现都指向同一处物理空间，无矛盾描述
items.enPass: Every appearance of a location points to the same physical space with no contradictions
items.zhFix: 统一空间描述并写入 GEO 平面图；跨 180° 轴线处补写「轴线切换」意图
items.enFix: Unify the spatial description into the GEO floor plan; at 180° axis crossings, write the axis change explicitly

items.zhQuestion: 角色的服装、伤妆、道具状态是否在剧本层面有变化记录？
items.enQuestion: Are wardrobe, injury makeup, and prop state changes recorded at the script level?
items.zhPass: 每处状态变化都有对应的情节原因，且变化点明确
items.enPass: Every state change has a plot cause and a clear change point
items.zhFix: 补写变化原因与发生镜次；无原因的变化一律视为连续性缺陷
items.enFix: Write the cause and the shot where it happens; a change without a cause is a continuity defect

items.zhQuestion: 是否存在超过模型单镜时长上限（12s）的连续动作或台词？
items.enQuestion: Is there continuous action or dialogue exceeding the model's per-shot ceiling (12s)?
items.zhPass: 拆解后每镜 ≤ 12s；单镜台词 ≤ 40 字（中文）/ 25 词（英文）
items.enPass: After splitting, every shot is ≤ 12s; per-shot dialogue ≤ 40 CJK chars / 25 English words
items.zhFix: 按 prompt-doctrine 的 long_dialogue_split（T1-T7）拆解，或在自然停顿处切镜
items.enFix: Split using prompt-doctrine's long_dialogue_split (T1-T7), or cut at a natural pause

items.zhQuestion: 是否存在需要多个物理事件才能完成的单镜？
items.enQuestion: Does any single shot require more than one physical event to complete?
items.zhPass: 每镜只承载一个物理事件（含首尾帧生成）；多余事件已拆分到相邻镜
items.enPass: Each shot carries exactly one physical event (including first/last-frame generation); extras are split into adjacent shots
items.zhFix: 拆分镜头；首尾帧生视频模式下尤其严格——两个以上事件会被模型自选执行顺序
items.enFix: Split the shot; this is strictest under first/last-frame generation, where two or more events let the model pick the order

items.zhQuestion: 是否使用了高风险运镜或特效（handheld / orbit / whip_pan / 多人形变）却没有单独试镜计划？
items.enQuestion: Are high-risk moves or VFX (handheld, orbit, whip_pan, multi-subject morph) used without an individual test-shot plan?
items.zhPass: 每个高风险项都有独立试镜安排，不进入批量生成
items.enPass: Every high-risk item has an individual test shot and is excluded from batch generation
items.zhFix: 先在单镜上验证；验证通过后再纳入批次，验证不过则改用 low/medium 风险的等效表达
items.enFix: Validate on a single shot first; only then include it in the batch — otherwise substitute an equivalent low/medium-risk treatment

items.zhQuestion: 是否包含可能被误读为真实事件/真实品牌的信息（虚构新闻、虚构产品、真实地名+负面情节）？
items.enQuestion: Does the script contain information that could be misread as a real event or brand (fictional news, fictional products, real place names paired with negative plots)?
items.zhPass: 虚构内容有明确虚构标记；不出现真实品牌标识与可识别的真实机构
items.enPass: Fictional content is clearly marked; no real brand marks or identifiable real institutions appear
items.zhFix: 改用虚构名称；确需真实地名时避免与负面情节绑定
items.enFix: Use invented names; when a real place is needed, avoid pairing it with negative plot

items.zhQuestion: 是否包含可能引发模仿的危险行为（高空、明火、驾驶分心、自伤）的详细步骤？
items.enQuestion: Does the script detail dangerous behavior that could be imitated (heights, open flame, distracted driving, self-harm)?
items.zhPass: 危险行为只呈现结果与氛围，不呈现可操作的步骤
items.enPass: Dangerous behavior shows only outcome and atmosphere, never operable steps
items.zhFix: 删去步骤细节；用反应镜与声音替代过程镜
items.enFix: Remove step details; replace process shots with reaction shots and sound

zh: 1. 读剧本，逐条回答 items 中的 zhQuestion；
2. 任一 blocker 未通过 → 停止，先修剧本，不得进入分镜与生成；
3. warn 未通过 → 写入交付清单的待复核项，成片前必须逐条复核并记录处置；
4. 全部通过后，把结果与剧本哈希一起存档，作为本片合规证据。
en: 1. Read the script and answer every zhQuestion/enQuestion in items;
2. Any blocker failing → stop, fix the script first, never proceed to storyboard or generation;
3. Warn failing → record in the delivery checklist's re-review list, and re-verify each item before delivery;
4. When all pass, archive the result together with the script hash as this film's compliance evidence.
